"""Seating charts: students sorted by last name, split into rows."""

import rosterkit.errors


def seating_rows(students, seats_per_row):
    """Return one text line per row of the seating chart."""
    if seats_per_row <= 0:
        raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError(
            "seats per row must be positive"
        )
    if not students:
        raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError("no students to seat")
    ordered = sorted(
        students,
        key=lambda item: (item.last_name, item.first_name),
    )
    lines = []
    for start in range(0, len(ordered), seats_per_row):
        chunk = ordered[start:start + seats_per_row]
        names = " | ".join(item.display_name for item in chunk)
        lines.append(f"Row {len(lines) + 1}: {names}")
    return lines


# end of file

cat > tests/test_seating.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import rosterkit.errors
import rosterkit.models
import rosterkit.seating

PAIR = 2


def make_student(last, first):
    return rosterkit.models.Student(
        student_id=last,
        last_name=last,
        first_name=first,
        section="A",
    )


class SeatingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.students = [
            make_student("Halloway", "Juno"),
            make_student("Dunmere", "Piet"),
            make_student("Zane", "Ola"),
        ]

    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_split(self):
        """Students are sorted by last name and split by row."""
        lines = rosterkit.seating.seating_rows(self.students, PAIR)
        self.assertTrue(
            lines
            == [
                "Row 1: Dunmere, Piet | Halloway, Juno",
                "Row 2: Zane, Ola",
            ]
        )

    def test_bad_seat_count_raises(self):
        """Zero or negative seats raise an error."""
        for seats in (0, -1):
            with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError):
                rosterkit.seating.seating_rows(self.students, seats)

    def test_no_students_raises(self):
        """An empty student list raises an error."""
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError):
            rosterkit.seating.seating_rows([], PAIR)


# end of file
EOF
